node.title: What Cannot Be Recovered Must Be Managed. Cross-series bridge: Human Intelligence Gap with AI Integrity Management
node.reading:
Document Status — Field Notes (Cross-Series Bridge) · Series: AI Integrity Management, Paper 5

This is a field-notes paper: a structured conceptual contribution grounded in direct practitioner observation, prior to formal working-paper development. It connects this series to the Human Intelligence Gap series, and states a mandate that follows from it. The argument turns on a claim this series treats as a working hypothesis, not a settled result: that the gap between feasible and actual human contribution is not only large but partly irreversible , leaving a residue that no amount of rationalisation or modernisation can recover. If that holds — and the Human Intelligence Gap measurement programme is built to test it — then the residue is not a project to be closed but a standing liability to be governed, and governing it is work this series has already argued belongs to a unified AI Integrity function. The paper does not leave that governance abstract: it states, concretely, how the remnant is managed — as a discipline of risk and selection rather than a promise of cleanup.

Why a Structural, Partly Irreversible Accumulation Cannot Be Solved by More Control — Why the Remnant It Leaves Behind Is the Natural Mandate of an Enterprise AI Integrity Function — and How That Remnant Is Managed, as a Discipline of Risk and the Selection of Initiatives by Fragility and Propagation

relations: The calibration case distinguishes knowledge that can be taught through practice from information that an application inventory cannot reconstruct by itself.
No todo saber tácito es irrecuperable; distinguir falta de captura, coste de recuperación y pérdida efectiva.
Information that was never institutionally established differs from information that existed but cannot be recovered from the available record.
Ambas categorías pueden coexistir en una decisión; clasificarlas exige evidencia del caso.
Where a record cannot reconstruct situated judgment, capability preservation may require a live transmission relationship rather than another layer of documentation.
No afirmar que todo conocimiento tácito sea irrecuperable ni que mentoría garantice reconstrucción completa.
Reconstructing what a model omitted is different from recovering a capability that has ceased to be exercised; the bridge note keeps those repair problems distinct.
La irreversibilidad del marco requiere contraste; el enlace distingue problemas y no establece una tasa universal de pérdida.
For a complementary reading, see [The structural limits of AI oversight](https://tegrity.ai/the-limits-of-ai-oversight/).
La fuente enlaza esta lectura en «Annex B — Cross-series bridge map» con el rótulo «HID ↔ AI Integrity Management».
